text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Trainer... We did it, we really did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With all the heavens observing my trial, I

managed to put on a race that will not
invite their
scorn. With this, my life has
run its course...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'm still alive and kicking, but
still... I'm
just so happy with this result!
Praise be!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, no need for that! I just did
what I
could.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Although... I can say that Suzuka and I
have
forged a brilliant testament to our
generation's
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, I guess so... But the next one
should be
easier, right?
choice_data_list_en: All right, let's move on to the next one.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We must consult the sticks! Oh, this doesn't bode well... Alas, there can be no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The divination stick is engraved with the

venerable crest of the Kikuka
chrysanthemum.
Which can only mean—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyahhhhh! Let it be anything but that!
Gods,
Buddha, Trainer, anyone—have
mercy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is 3,000 meters long!
And the
dreaded Yodo Hill on the third
corner is even
steeper than the abyss
that leads to the
underworld!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't have enough luck for that kind of
distance!
Let's go somewhere shorter!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urk... You're right. The gods do work in

mysterious ways...
choice_data_list_en: Still, it was just the fortune's result.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So be it! Even bad—nay, grave
circumstances can
still be turned around!
